title: Finetune provenance manifest entry
description: One JSONL record per material row. Every material that lands under data/finetune/ (warehouse extraction, open-source intake, or human annotation) MUST carry these provenance fields so tier filtering and the bronze guard can operate on a uniform shape.

dataset.description: Which dataset this material feeds: judge-c | drafter-a | warehouse | opensource. Warehouse/opensource are raw material pools; judge-c/drafter-a are the schema-validated training datasets.

source.description: Origin of the material: warehouse (law-bench DB tables) | opensource (external corpus) | human (human annotation).

license.description: SPDX identifier or 'proprietary' (warehouse material is the project's own data, tagged 'proprietary'). Open-source must be Apache-2.0 or MIT to enter the pool (license gate).

tier.description: Data tier. gold = human gold rubric+criteria / human-verified body, direct ground truth. silver = LLM draft (pipeline_runs.filled_text), SFT warmup only. bronze = machine self-eval (eval_criteria_results.verdict), NEVER ground truth (exporter hard-guarded). raw = structural backbone (clauses) + judge input pool, no label semantics.

provenance.description: Stable handle locating the source row. For warehouse material: '<table>:<id>'. For open-source: '<repo>:<doc_id>'. For human annotation: 'human:<annotator>:<batch>'.

row_ref.description: Relative path to the material file under data/finetune/, so the manifest is self-resolving. Optional for human-annotated material produced directly into a dataset file.
